documents.title: General Terms

sections.heading: General content
content: These General Terms (“GCC”) apply to Guests and Partners who use or book services at Vinpearl branded hotels, resorts, and other brands owned, managed and/or operated by Vinpearl (if any) in the future (“Hotels”). Customers, Partners and Vinpearl are individually referred to as “Parties” and collectively as “Parties”.

Guest/Partner agrees and acknowledges that by sending Vinpearl a booking request, event request and/or additional services (collectively, “Service Request”) and having Vinpearl confirm the service, the Guest and Partner have read and accepted the GTC, General Regulations (“QDC”) and the changes to GTC, QDC from time to time posted on Vinpearl's official website at the address https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/dieu-khoan-chung and https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-chung (“Website”) as well as service provision policies and service quotes notified and provided by Vinpearl.
GTC is an inseparable part of the contract, agreement to provide and use services or Service Request confirmed between Vinpearl and Customers/Partners ("Contract").

sections.heading: ARTICLE 1. DEFINITIONS
content: 1. “Vinpearl” means Vinpearl Joint Stock Company, affiliated companies of Vinpearl Joint Stock Company and branches, representative offices, business locations of Vinpearl and affiliated companies of Vinpearl established nationwide from time to time.
2. “Partner” means a travel agent/travel agency/business/organization or individual entering into a Contract with Vinpearl.
3. "Customer" is an individual who uses Vinpearl's services for direct consumption purposes, not for resale to other individuals or organizations.
4. “A” is understood as Adult. “C” is understood as Children.
5. “B2B” is a commercial transaction between Businesses and Businesses (without the participation of individual Customers).
6. “B2C” is commercial transactions that take place between businesses and individual customers.
7. “Published Price” is the room price and service price listed at the Hotel and on Vinpearl's website www.vinpearl.com. Room prices may change daily.
8. “Static Room Price” is a price that does not change according to changes in the published price.
9. “Room Package Price” is the price for the night stay with the services listed in the corresponding Room Package.
10. “Room Package” is the common name of the following Reservation Requests and or any new service packages announced by Vinpearl from time to time:

11. “Services” include accommodation services, parties, events, golf, Vouchers or other additional services that Vinpearl provides from time to time such as transportation, entertainment services...
12. “Retail Guest” is a Guest or group of Guests with a maximum number of reservations at Service Request of 09 rooms/night or 04 villas/night.
13. “Guest Group” is a group of Guests with a booking quantity of 10 rooms/night or more or 05 villas/night or more and/or services (banquets, events, golf and other services) at Reservation Request.
14. “Series Group” is a group booked in series with at least 3 groups or more following the same schedule.
15. “Working Day” is the day from Monday to Friday every week, excluding holidays and legal holidays.

16. “No-Show” is the case where the Guest does not arrive to check in until 11:59 p.m. on the check-in date or at another time during the stay as notified by the Guest/Partner and Vinpearl will return the room to the available room fund for sale after this time limit without notifying the Guest/Partner if the Guest is not present and completes check-in procedures.

17. “QDC” are the regulations that Guests must comply with during their stay and use of Services at the Hotel and may be amended and supplemented at Vinpearl's discretion from time to time and posted on Vinpearl's Website.
18. “Total Service Fee” includes the total Room Package Price for the entire stay and additional services other than those listed in the Room Package.

19. “Voucher” is a card/voucher to purchase prepaid Services in physical form or electronic data issued by Vinpearl to record the right to use the Room Package for the Voucher owner. The use of Voucher must comply with QDC, GTC and detailed regulations of each Voucher.

20. “Group Service Confirmation” is Vinpearl's confirmation of the Guest/Partner's Service Request for booking accommodation services, organizing events at the Hotel, vouchers or other additional services of Group Guests with the contents according to the form issued with these GTC.

21. “Retail Customer Service Confirmation” is Vinpearl's confirmation of the Customer/Partner's Service Request regarding the booking of accommodation services, vouchers or other additional services of the Retail Customer with the contents according to the form issued with these GTC.

sections.heading: ARTICLE 2. VOUCHERS
content: Unless otherwise agreed or Vinpearl has another policy, Customers using Vouchers must comply with the provisions in the GTC, QDC, other conditions specified on the Voucher and/or the Service provision policy corresponding to the type of Voucher issued by Vinpearl at the time the Customer uses it. Original voucher must be presented and recovered at time of check-in. In case a valid Voucher cannot be presented, the Guest must pay directly according to the Published Price at the time of check-in.

sections.heading: ARTICLE 3. CHECK IN AND CHECK OUT REGULATIONS:
content: 1. Check-in and check-out time
Unless otherwise notified and/or confirmed by the Hotel, check-in and check-out regulations apply as follows:
Category | Regulations | Notes
Check-in time | - Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang: 14:00 on arrival - Other hotels: 15:00 on arrival
Check-out time | No later than 12:00 noon on check-out date

Early check-in fee before 6:00 am | 100% Price for 1 room night | Subject to room availability and Vinpearl's confirmation. Fees will have to be paid immediately at the time of confirmation by Vinpearl.
Early check-in fee from 6:00 am to 12:00 noon | 50% of Room Package Price includes breakfast. Meals and guest services (if needed) will be paid at the published price at the hotel.
Late check-out fee from after 12:00 to 18:00 | 50% of Room Price does not include meals & other services. Meals and incidental services (if needed) will be paid at the published price at the hotel.
Late check-out fee after 18:00 | 100% Price for 1 room night

After completing the check-in procedures, the Guest will have to pay the Room Package Rate for the entire stay period as registered with the Hotel, regardless of whether the Guest checks out before the check-out time.

2. The above mentioned early check-in/late check-out fees will be calculated according to (i) Vinpearl's Published Price (including promotional program price if applicable at the time of payment) when Guest pays directly to Vinpearl or (ii) contractual/agreement price (including promotional program price if applicable at the time of payment) between Vinpearl and Partner if Partner is the paying party.

3. Vinpearl will record the image of the Customer's face when checking in for management using Facial Recognition Technology. By agreeing to check in, the Customer is understood to have been informed of this by Vinpearl and agrees that Vinpearl has the right to use the Customer's image as stipulated in Article 9.

sections.heading: ARTICLE 4. BOOKING POLICY
content: 1. All Service Requests and Room Allocation Lists of Guests/Partners must be sent to Vinpearl in the form of email or text before Guests check in.
2. In case the Agent books a villa (Villa) for 1 group or many different groups of Guests, the Partner must ensure:
a) Room Package prices are based on the default of 02 adults in 1 hotel room or 01 villa bedroom if not mentioned in the Appendices related to room prices.

b) The Partner needs to notify all Guests that: (i) Guests will be sharing a villa with other guests booking through the Partner; (ii) Guests take care of their personal property when sharing a villa with other guests. Partners bear all related responsibilities if complaints or disputes arise.
c) Vinpearl is exempted from responsibility in resolving conflicts/disputes between Guests sharing the villa.
3. Reservation information: details at PL 01

sections.heading: 4. Regulations on accommodation:
content: a) The maximum number of guests per hotel room (except for special cases clearly stated) applies as follows:
(i) Maximum 04 people in 1 bedroom including children under 4 years old: 03A & 01C/ 02A & 02C.
(ii) Each room can only book 01 extra bed depending on the policy applied at each hotel.
(iii) Surcharge applies for children from 4 years old to under 12 years old and adult surcharge - for guests from 12 years old.
b) Maximum number of Guests per Villa is applied as follows:
(i) Each bedroom: maximum 02 A and 02 C for under 12 years old
(ii) Surcharge applies to children from 4 years old to under 12 years old.
(iii) No extra beds in villas, except Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang.

5. Special cases: in some special cases (including but not limited to: force majeure events, Hotel upgrades and repairs, etc.), Vinpearl has the right to relocate the Guest to another room type/Hotel with standards equivalent to the room type/Hotel that the Guest/Partner booked and which was confirmed by Vinpearl.

sections.heading: 6. Information provided to the Hotel
content: 6.1. Information provided before arrival date
a. In order for Guests to receive the best quality of service from the Hotel and ensure security for Guests, Guests/Partners need to provide the Hotel's reservation department:
(i) List of all Customers (full name, date of birth, gender, identity card/citizen identification card, passport number, nationality, copy of temporary residence card):
+ Retail guests: Must be sent to the Hotel's reservations department by the deadline below from the date of receipt of the booking confirmation, but no later than the no-charge cancellation deadline:
* Low season: 7 days
* Peak season: 15 days
* Peak holiday season: At the time of booking
+ Group guests: Details according to the group contract.

(ii) Flight information and expected arrival time to the Hotel need to be provided to the Hotel at least 05 days before the Guest's arrival date in case the Guest requests pick-up and drop-off services.

(iii) If the Guest/Partner does not provide the reservation list on time, Vinpearl has the right to cancel the reservation from the system, refuse to apply preferential prices according to the Voucher, confirm the Service Request, agreement, and contract signed between the Guest/Partner and Vinpearl. In that case, Vinpearl will apply the Published Price at the Hotel on the day the Guest checks in if there is room available, and the Partner will be fully responsible for resolving Guest complaints arising from the late provision of information.

(iv) Depending on the booked Service Request, if the service is Full-board, the meal sequence includes: dinner on the day of arrival, breakfast, lunch and dinners on the following days until breakfast and lunch on the day the Guest checks out. If Guest wants to change lunch on check-out date to lunch on arrival date, Guest/Partner must notify the Hotel reservation department at least 05 days before Guest's arrival date. Meal changes are only applicable to guests who check in before 13:00 on the day of arrival and check out before lunch on the day of departure.
(v) Other special requests such as rooms on high floors, adjacent rooms..., will be accommodated depending on the Hotel's availability at the time of check-in.
b. Change information:

Any changes in meal and service information arising from the original Service Request need to be sent to the Hotel's reservations department and confirmed by the Reservations Department at least 05 days before the Guest's check-in date. If the change is not confirmed in advance, Vinpearl has the right to take the following measures simultaneously:
+ The Published Price at the Hotel applies on the day the Guest checks in and the Partner will take full responsibility for resolving Guest complaints arising from the late provision of information.

+ In case there are additional Guests (including children) without prior confirmation, Guests/Partners will have to pay a corresponding surcharge according to the Hotel's Published Price List at the time of check-in. In case the booking is made through the Partner, the Partner will have to pay the surcharge directly or Vinpearl has the right to deduct the surcharge from any payment made by the Partner to Vinpearl.
6.2. Check-in procedures

a. Guests are required to present ID card or passport and/or Birth Certificate for children and take photos upon check-in for registration purposes, the Hotel will keep a copy of these documents. In case the Guest cannot present the child's birth certificate, the Guest/Partner agrees to use the child's height to determine the child's age, specifically as follows:
Height | Age
Under 1m | Under 4 years old
1m-1m40 | From 4 years old to under 12 years old
Over 1m40 | From 12 years old

b. By agreeing to purchase and use Vinpearl's services, Guests agree to allow Vinpearl to take photos and use Guest's images for statistical and accommodation management purposes. Vinpearl commits not to use/provide Guest's images to third parties (not part of Vingroup) for other purposes unless done at the request of a competent state agency or with the prior consent of the Guest.

c. Guests must make a deposit at the time of check-in to cover additional Service Requests arising at the Hotel and/or other damages to the Hotel (if any) caused by the Guest during their stay. The deposit will be refunded by Vinpearl to the Guest at the time of check-out if the service is not used and/or no damage is incurred to the Hotel. The deposit is made in cash, bank card or credit card with the specific deposit level as follows:
(i) Hotel Room: 1,000,000 VND/room/night
(ii) Villa: 3,000,000 VND/Villa/night

Vinpearl has the right to refuse to provide the Service if the Customer does not make a deposit according to the above regulations. In case the booking is made through the Partner, the Partner is responsible for making the deposit on behalf of the Guest in case the Guest does not make the deposit to Vinpearl. If the Partner does not deposit according to regulations, the room without deposit will apply according to the No-Show policy specified in these GCC.
6.3. Airport pick-up and drop-off service:
a. For Hotels that provide free airport pick-up and drop-off services, no cancellation fees apply to this service.

b. For hotels that provide paid airport pick-up and drop-off services, detailed information about vehicle type, usage fees, cancellation fees, etc. is provided in advance in the booking confirmation of each hotel.

c. In case of booking a private car, the flight number and flight time must be provided to the Hotel at least 05 days before check-in date so that the Hotel can arrange pick-up and drop-off. If there are changes or cancellation of pick-up or drop-off requests, it is necessary to notify the Hotel at least 03 days (72 hours) before check-in date. Any notification after this deadline will be subject to a cancellation fee.

d. The airport receptionist will welcome guests at Vinpearl's reception desk located in the arrival lobby area. Please look for the pick-up sign or contact the airport front desk via the contact number provided in the Service Request confirmation.

e. For free drop off service, Guests need to be at the Hotel lobby area 15 minutes before departure time. In case of delay, the hotel's shuttle bus will still move to the airport to ensure it does not affect other guests. Guests arriving late will be responsible for their own transportation costs to the airport.

sections.heading: ARTICLE 5. VINPEARL PAYMENT ACCOUNT
content: 1. Unless paying by credit card, cash or otherwise agreed in writing, Guest/Partner will make payment directly to the account. List of accounts at PL02
2. Transfer content: (i) Name of Customer/Partner; (ii) Booking Request/Event Request Number; (iii) Payment type (deposit, payment...).

3. Vinpearl has the right to (i) change or supplement the payment receiving account number mentioned above; and/or (ii) make additional changes to the payment process and notify Customers/Partners in advance in writing or post on the Website.

sections.heading: ARTICLE 6. REPAIR AND RENOVATION
content: 1. Vinpearl has the right to repair, renovate or upgrade/ carry out periodic maintenance programs suitable for the purpose of maintaining the best conditions for the Hotel. Vinpearl has the full right to make its own decisions on repairs and upgrades, but must notify Partners and/or Guests by email/fax before starting major and long-term upgrade projects that may affect Guest satisfaction.

2. Vinpearl will not be responsible for any claims or demands for losses and/or damages that the Dealer and/or customer will encounter due to renovation/upgrade after notifying the Dealer/Partner/customer in advance.

sections.heading: ARTICLE 7. FORCE MAJEURE
content: Vinpearl, Customers or Partners will not be responsible for delay or non-performance of the contract/agreement to provide and use services (except payment obligations) or the rights and obligations of each Party specified in the DKC and QDC if such delay or non-performance is caused by a Force Majeure event. Force Majeure events include but are not limited to: Storms, floods, earthquakes, wars, fires, changes in state policies and laws or other objective events.
With conditions:

That event is completely beyond the reasonable control or is not due to the fault or negligence of the Party affected by the Force Majeure event, even though that Party has applied all necessary measures and within the allowable capacity to prevent, overcome or reduce damage, causing delay or interruption or delay in the performance of obligations in this Contract;

Within 03 days from the date of the Force Majeure event, the Party affected by the force majeure event must notify the other Party in writing, detailing the Force Majeure event, measures taken to prevent and overcome damage, proposed recovery plan and resolution measures.

Unless otherwise agreed by Vinpearl in writing, the Guest or Partner must still perform their obligations under the Contract in accordance with the actual circumstances and must take all reasonable measures to perform the tasks not hindered by Force Majeure Events.

sections.heading: ARTICLE 8. INFORMATION SECURITY
content: 1. The Partner and Vinpearl commit that, during the validity period of the Contract and after the Contract between the Partner and Vinpeal terminates, the Disclosing Party will absolutely keep confidential information ("Confidential Information") of the Disclosing Party. Accordingly, the Disclosing Party may not disclose Confidential Information to any third party, whether directly or indirectly, under any circumstances, without the disclosing Party's written consent except as provided below. For the purposes specified in this article, Confidential Information is understood as information including but not limited to the terms of the Contract signed between Vinpearl and the Partner, and/or information, data, documents created in connection with or arising from the performance of the Contract, information, data, documents provided by the Disclosing Party to the Disclosing Party in any form to implement the Contract. In addition, Confidential Information also includes but is not limited to information related to business secrets, technological secrets, trade secrets, knowledge or other information about or serving the disclosing Party's financial and business marketing.
2. The Obligation of Confidentiality is excluded if the Confidential Information:
a. has been widely disseminated to the public by the disclosing Party;

b. provided by the Disclosing Party to employees, financial, legal consultants or contractors of the Disclosing Party for the purpose of performing the Disclosing Party's obligations under this Contract, provided that the Disclosing Party shall be responsible and ensure that the subjects to whom the Confidential Information is disclosed must comply with the confidentiality regulations as stated above;
c. received by the Disclosing Party from a third party independent of the performance of this Agreement without any obligation of confidentiality; or
d. required to be disclosed by a competent authority or any court having appropriate jurisdiction over the Disclosing Party.

3. The Disclosing Party agrees that any violation of this Confidentiality Obligation may cause irreparable damage to the Disclosing Party, accordingly the Disclosing Party will have the right to seek measures to mitigate the damages and force the Disclosing Party to compensate for all damages in an amount not less than the Contract Value.

sections.heading: ARTICLE 9. RIGHT TO USE GUEST'S IMAGES
content: 1. Vinpearl applies facial recognition technology to manage customer data when entering/exiting hotels/resorts, using services at Vinpearl's restaurants, entertainment areas... to save time and ensure security and safety for guests when using Vinpearl's services.
2. Guests agree and allow Vinpearl to collect and use images of their faces for management using facial recognition technology during their stay and use of services at Vinpearl.
3. The use of images of Guests' faces mentioned in this Article is completely free.
4. Vinpearl commits that guests' facial images will be kept confidential and used only for the purposes stated in these General Terms.

sections.heading: ARTICLE 10. DISPUTE RESOLUTION
content: The provisions in DKC and QDC will be governed by Vietnamese law. All disputes arising related to the request and use of Services by Customers/Partners according to the provisions of the Contract and GTC, QDC will be attempted to be resolved through negotiation. In case negotiations are not successful within 30 days from the date the dispute arises, the Parties will have the right to bring the dispute to resolution at a competent Court in Vietnam according to the provisions of law.

sections.heading: ARTICLE 11. TECHNICAL ERRORS
content: 1. Vinpearl will make reasonable efforts to maintain the normal operation of the e-commerce website booking.vinpearl.com (“Website”). However, Vinpearl does not guarantee that (i) the functions and support tools provided on the Website will be uninterrupted or error-free, (ii) the Website is not infected with viruses, malware or other harmful components, and/or (iii) all data provided on the Website is accurate and free of technical errors during the data creation process.

2. In case of technical problems such as machine problems, software errors, internet connection system errors, virus-infected Website (“Technical Errors”) or errors in data posted on the Website such as pricing errors (“Data Errors”), Vinpearl will make reasonable efforts to correct Technical Errors or correct Data Errors as soon as possible.
3. Vinpearl has the right to refuse to carry out established transactions:

(i) due to Technical Errors, (ii) on the basis of Data Errors, and/or (iii) affected by Technical Errors and/or Data Errors regardless of the source of such errors. For clarity, a data error is an error on the Site (e.g. price, conditions) that a reasonable person would not consider normal. In case of refusal to carry out the transaction, Vinpearl will notify you via the email you provided when booking the service, and at the same time refund the payment related to the refused transaction that you have paid to Vinpearl within a maximum of 45 working days.

4. In addition to the obligation to refund the payment received as stipulated in Point (c), Vinpearl is not responsible for any loss or damage that you suffer, whether directly or indirectly, arising from or related to Technical Errors and/or Data Errors.

General Terms

General content

These General Terms (“GCC”) apply to Guests and Partners who use or book services at Vinpearl branded hotels, resorts, and other brands owned, managed and/or operated by Vinpearl (if any) in the future (“Hotels”). Customers, Partners and Vinpearl are individually referred to as “Parties” and collectively as “Parties”.

Guest/Partner agrees and acknowledges that by sending Vinpearl a booking request, event request and/or additional services (collectively, “Service Request”) and having Vinpearl confirm the service, the Guest and Partner have read and accepted the GTC, General Regulations (“QDC”) and the changes to GTC, QDC from time to time posted on Vinpearl's official website at the address https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/dieu-khoan-chung and https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-chung (“Website”) as well as service provision policies and service quotes notified and provided by Vinpearl.

GTC is an inseparable part of the contract, agreement to provide and use services or Service Request confirmed between Vinpearl and Customers/Partners ("Contract").

ARTICLE 1. DEFINITIONS

1. “Vinpearl” means Vinpearl Joint Stock Company, affiliated companies of Vinpearl Joint Stock Company and branches, representative offices, business locations of Vinpearl and affiliated companies of Vinpearl established nationwide from time to time.

2. “Partner” means a travel agent/travel agency/business/organization or individual entering into a Contract with Vinpearl.

3. "Customer" is an individual who uses Vinpearl's services for direct consumption purposes, not for resale to other individuals or organizations.

4. “A” is understood as Adult. “C” is understood as Children.

5. “B2B” is a commercial transaction between Businesses and Businesses (without the participation of individual Customers).

6. “B2C” is commercial transactions that take place between businesses and individual customers.

7. “Published Price” is the room price and service price listed at the Hotel and on Vinpearl's website www.vinpearl.com. Room prices may change daily.

8. “Static Room Price” is a price that does not change according to changes in the published price.

9. “Room Package Price” is the price for the night stay with the services listed in the corresponding Room Package.

10. “Room Package” is the common name of the following Reservation Requests and or any new service packages announced by Vinpearl from time to time:

STT | Room Packages | Interpretation | Description

1 | RO | Room Only | Includes overnight stay only

2 | BB | Bed & Breakfast | Includes 1 night stay and 1 breakfast

3 | HB | Half-board | Includes overnight stay and 02 meals: breakfast and lunch or dinner according to the Guest's choice

4 | FB | Full-board | Includes 3 nights' stay and 3 meals: dinner on arrival day, breakfast and lunch on departure day

5 | ROV | Only with VinWonders | Includes unlimited nights stay and entertainment at VinWondwers

6 | BBV/BV | Bed and Breakfast with VinWonders | BB Room package includes unlimited fun at VinWonders

7 | BBVS/BX | Bed and Breakfast with VinWonders and Vinpearl Safari | BB Room package includes unlimited fun at VinWonders and Vinpearl Safari

8 | BBW/BW | Bed and Breakfast with Water Park | BB Room Package includes unlimited fun at the Water Park

9 | FBV/ FV | Full-board with VinWonders | FB Room package includes unlimited fun at VinWonders

10 | FBVS/ FX | Full-board with VinWonders and Vinpearl Safari | FB Room Package includes unlimited fun at VinWonders and Vinpearl Safari

11 | FBW/FW | Full-board with Water Park | FB Room Package includes unlimited fun at Water Park

12 | FBSFD | Full-board Seafood dinner | FB Room Package includes Seafood dinner at the restaurant

13 | FVSFD | Full-board Seafood dinner with VinWonders | FB Room Package with Seafood dinner at the restaurant and unlimited entertainment at VinWonders.

14 | FXSFD | Full-board Seafood dinner VinWonders and Vinpearl Safari | FB Room Package with Seafood dinner at the restaurant plus unlimited fun at VinWonders and Vinpearl Safari

15 | FWSFD | Full-board Seafood dinner with Water Park | FB Room Package with Seafood dinner at the restaurant and unlimited fun at Water Park

16 | FBBQD | Full-board BBQ dinner | FB Room Package includes BBQ dinner at the Villa

17 | FVBQD | Full-board BBQ dinner with VinWonders | FB Room Package with BBQ dinner at the Villa and unlimited fun at VinWonders

18 | FXBQD | Full-board BBQ dinner VinWonders and Vinpearl Safari | FB Room Package with BBQ dinner at the Villa plus unlimited fun at VinWonders and Vinpearl Safari

19 | FWBQD | Full-board BBQ dinner with Water Park | FB Room Package with BBQ dinner at the Villa plus unlimited fun at Water Park

20 | G1P | Golf for 01 player | Room Package includes overnight stay and green fees (18 holes) for 1 player

21 | G2P | Golf for 02 players | Room Package includes overnight stay and green fees (18 holes) for 2 players

11. “Services” include accommodation services, parties, events, golf, Vouchers or other additional services that Vinpearl provides from time to time such as transportation, entertainment services...

12. “Retail Guest” is a Guest or group of Guests with a maximum number of reservations at Service Request of 09 rooms/night or 04 villas/night.

13. “Guest Group” is a group of Guests with a booking quantity of 10 rooms/night or more or 05 villas/night or more and/or services (banquets, events, golf and other services) at Reservation Request.

14. “Series Group” is a group booked in series with at least 3 groups or more following the same schedule.

15. “Working Day” is the day from Monday to Friday every week, excluding holidays and legal holidays.

16. “No-Show” is the case where the Guest does not arrive to check in until 11:59 p.m. on the check-in date or at another time during the stay as notified by the Guest/Partner and Vinpearl will return the room to the available room fund for sale after this time limit without notifying the Guest/Partner if the Guest is not present and completes check-in procedures.

17. “QDC” are the regulations that Guests must comply with during their stay and use of Services at the Hotel and may be amended and supplemented at Vinpearl's discretion from time to time and posted on Vinpearl's Website.

18. “Total Service Fee” includes the total Room Package Price for the entire stay and additional services other than those listed in the Room Package.

19. “Voucher” is a card/voucher to purchase prepaid Services in physical form or electronic data issued by Vinpearl to record the right to use the Room Package for the Voucher owner. The use of Voucher must comply with QDC, GTC and detailed regulations of each Voucher.

20. “Group Service Confirmation” is Vinpearl's confirmation of the Guest/Partner's Service Request for booking accommodation services, organizing events at the Hotel, vouchers or other additional services of Group Guests with the contents according to the form issued with these GTC.

21. “Retail Customer Service Confirmation” is Vinpearl's confirmation of the Customer/Partner's Service Request regarding the booking of accommodation services, vouchers or other additional services of the Retail Customer with the contents according to the form issued with these GTC.

ARTICLE 2. VOUCHERS

Unless otherwise agreed or Vinpearl has another policy, Customers using Vouchers must comply with the provisions in the GTC, QDC, other conditions specified on the Voucher and/or the Service provision policy corresponding to the type of Voucher issued by Vinpearl at the time the Customer uses it. Original voucher must be presented and recovered at time of check-in. In case a valid Voucher cannot be presented, the Guest must pay directly according to the Published Price at the time of check-in.

ARTICLE 3. CHECK IN AND CHECK OUT REGULATIONS:

1. Check-in and check-out time

Unless otherwise notified and/or confirmed by the Hotel, check-in and check-out regulations apply as follows:

Category | Regulations | Notes

Check-in time | - Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang: 14:00 on arrival - Other hotels: 15:00 on arrival

Check-out time | No later than 12:00 noon on check-out date

Early check-in fee before 6:00 am | 100% Price for 1 room night | Subject to room availability and Vinpearl's confirmation. Fees will have to be paid immediately at the time of confirmation by Vinpearl.

Early check-in fee from 6:00 am to 12:00 noon | 50% of Room Package Price includes breakfast. Meals and guest services (if needed) will be paid at the published price at the hotel.

Late check-out fee from after 12:00 to 18:00 | 50% of Room Price does not include meals & other services. Meals and incidental services (if needed) will be paid at the published price at the hotel.

Late check-out fee after 18:00 | 100% Price for 1 room night

After completing the check-in procedures, the Guest will have to pay the Room Package Rate for the entire stay period as registered with the Hotel, regardless of whether the Guest checks out before the check-out time.

2. The above mentioned early check-in/late check-out fees will be calculated according to (i) Vinpearl's Published Price (including promotional program price if applicable at the time of payment) when Guest pays directly to Vinpearl or (ii) contractual/agreement price (including promotional program price if applicable at the time of payment) between Vinpearl and Partner if Partner is the paying party.

3. Vinpearl will record the image of the Customer's face when checking in for management using Facial Recognition Technology. By agreeing to check in, the Customer is understood to have been informed of this by Vinpearl and agrees that Vinpearl has the right to use the Customer's image as stipulated in Article 9.

ARTICLE 4. BOOKING POLICY

1. All Service Requests and Room Allocation Lists of Guests/Partners must be sent to Vinpearl in the form of email or text before Guests check in.

2. In case the Agent books a villa (Villa) for 1 group or many different groups of Guests, the Partner must ensure:

a) Room Package prices are based on the default of 02 adults in 1 hotel room or 01 villa bedroom if not mentioned in the Appendices related to room prices.

b) The Partner needs to notify all Guests that: (i) Guests will be sharing a villa with other guests booking through the Partner; (ii) Guests take care of their personal property when sharing a villa with other guests. Partners bear all related responsibilities if complaints or disputes arise.

c) Vinpearl is exempted from responsibility in resolving conflicts/disputes between Guests sharing the villa.

3. Reservation information: details at PL 01

4. Regulations on accommodation:

a) The maximum number of guests per hotel room (except for special cases clearly stated) applies as follows:

(i) Maximum 04 people in 1 bedroom including children under 4 years old: 03A & 01C/ 02A & 02C.

(ii) Each room can only book 01 extra bed depending on the policy applied at each hotel.

(iii) Surcharge applies for children from 4 years old to under 12 years old and adult surcharge - for guests from 12 years old.

b) Maximum number of Guests per Villa is applied as follows:

(i) Each bedroom: maximum 02 A and 02 C for under 12 years old

(ii) Surcharge applies to children from 4 years old to under 12 years old.

(iii) No extra beds in villas, except Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang.

5. Special cases: in some special cases (including but not limited to: force majeure events, Hotel upgrades and repairs, etc.), Vinpearl has the right to relocate the Guest to another room type/Hotel with standards equivalent to the room type/Hotel that the Guest/Partner booked and which was confirmed by Vinpearl.

6. Information provided to the Hotel

6.1. Information provided before arrival date

a. In order for Guests to receive the best quality of service from the Hotel and ensure security for Guests, Guests/Partners need to provide the Hotel's reservation department:

(i) List of all Customers (full name, date of birth, gender, identity card/citizen identification card, passport number, nationality, copy of temporary residence card):

+ Retail guests: Must be sent to the Hotel's reservations department by the deadline below from the date of receipt of the booking confirmation, but no later than the no-charge cancellation deadline:

* Low season: 7 days

* Peak season: 15 days

* Peak holiday season: At the time of booking

+ Group guests: Details according to the group contract.

(ii) Flight information and expected arrival time to the Hotel need to be provided to the Hotel at least 05 days before the Guest's arrival date in case the Guest requests pick-up and drop-off services.

(iii) If the Guest/Partner does not provide the reservation list on time, Vinpearl has the right to cancel the reservation from the system, refuse to apply preferential prices according to the Voucher, confirm the Service Request, agreement, and contract signed between the Guest/Partner and Vinpearl. In that case, Vinpearl will apply the Published Price at the Hotel on the day the Guest checks in if there is room available, and the Partner will be fully responsible for resolving Guest complaints arising from the late provision of information.

(iv) Depending on the booked Service Request, if the service is Full-board, the meal sequence includes: dinner on the day of arrival, breakfast, lunch and dinners on the following days until breakfast and lunch on the day the Guest checks out. If Guest wants to change lunch on check-out date to lunch on arrival date, Guest/Partner must notify the Hotel reservation department at least 05 days before Guest's arrival date. Meal changes are only applicable to guests who check in before 13:00 on the day of arrival and check out before lunch on the day of departure.

(v) Other special requests such as rooms on high floors, adjacent rooms..., will be accommodated depending on the Hotel's availability at the time of check-in.

b. Change information:

Any changes in meal and service information arising from the original Service Request need to be sent to the Hotel's reservations department and confirmed by the Reservations Department at least 05 days before the Guest's check-in date. If the change is not confirmed in advance, Vinpearl has the right to take the following measures simultaneously:

+ The Published Price at the Hotel applies on the day the Guest checks in and the Partner will take full responsibility for resolving Guest complaints arising from the late provision of information.

+ In case there are additional Guests (including children) without prior confirmation, Guests/Partners will have to pay a corresponding surcharge according to the Hotel's Published Price List at the time of check-in. In case the booking is made through the Partner, the Partner will have to pay the surcharge directly or Vinpearl has the right to deduct the surcharge from any payment made by the Partner to Vinpearl.

6.2. Check-in procedures

a. Guests are required to present ID card or passport and/or Birth Certificate for children and take photos upon check-in for registration purposes, the Hotel will keep a copy of these documents. In case the Guest cannot present the child's birth certificate, the Guest/Partner agrees to use the child's height to determine the child's age, specifically as follows:

Height | Age

Under 1m | Under 4 years old

1m-1m40 | From 4 years old to under 12 years old

Over 1m40 | From 12 years old

b. By agreeing to purchase and use Vinpearl's services, Guests agree to allow Vinpearl to take photos and use Guest's images for statistical and accommodation management purposes. Vinpearl commits not to use/provide Guest's images to third parties (not part of Vingroup) for other purposes unless done at the request of a competent state agency or with the prior consent of the Guest.

c. Guests must make a deposit at the time of check-in to cover additional Service Requests arising at the Hotel and/or other damages to the Hotel (if any) caused by the Guest during their stay. The deposit will be refunded by Vinpearl to the Guest at the time of check-out if the service is not used and/or no damage is incurred to the Hotel. The deposit is made in cash, bank card or credit card with the specific deposit level as follows:

(i) Hotel Room: 1,000,000 VND/room/night

(ii) Villa: 3,000,000 VND/Villa/night

Vinpearl has the right to refuse to provide the Service if the Customer does not make a deposit according to the above regulations. In case the booking is made through the Partner, the Partner is responsible for making the deposit on behalf of the Guest in case the Guest does not make the deposit to Vinpearl. If the Partner does not deposit according to regulations, the room without deposit will apply according to the No-Show policy specified in these GCC.

6.3. Airport pick-up and drop-off service:

a. For Hotels that provide free airport pick-up and drop-off services, no cancellation fees apply to this service.

b. For hotels that provide paid airport pick-up and drop-off services, detailed information about vehicle type, usage fees, cancellation fees, etc. is provided in advance in the booking confirmation of each hotel.

c. In case of booking a private car, the flight number and flight time must be provided to the Hotel at least 05 days before check-in date so that the Hotel can arrange pick-up and drop-off. If there are changes or cancellation of pick-up or drop-off requests, it is necessary to notify the Hotel at least 03 days (72 hours) before check-in date. Any notification after this deadline will be subject to a cancellation fee.

d. The airport receptionist will welcome guests at Vinpearl's reception desk located in the arrival lobby area. Please look for the pick-up sign or contact the airport front desk via the contact number provided in the Service Request confirmation.

e. For free drop off service, Guests need to be at the Hotel lobby area 15 minutes before departure time. In case of delay, the hotel's shuttle bus will still move to the airport to ensure it does not affect other guests. Guests arriving late will be responsible for their own transportation costs to the airport.

ARTICLE 5. VINPEARL PAYMENT ACCOUNT

1. Unless paying by credit card, cash or otherwise agreed in writing, Guest/Partner will make payment directly to the account. List of accounts at PL02

2. Transfer content: (i) Name of Customer/Partner; (ii) Booking Request/Event Request Number; (iii) Payment type (deposit, payment...).

3. Vinpearl has the right to (i) change or supplement the payment receiving account number mentioned above; and/or (ii) make additional changes to the payment process and notify Customers/Partners in advance in writing or post on the Website.

ARTICLE 6. REPAIR AND RENOVATION

1. Vinpearl has the right to repair, renovate or upgrade/ carry out periodic maintenance programs suitable for the purpose of maintaining the best conditions for the Hotel. Vinpearl has the full right to make its own decisions on repairs and upgrades, but must notify Partners and/or Guests by email/fax before starting major and long-term upgrade projects that may affect Guest satisfaction.

2. Vinpearl will not be responsible for any claims or demands for losses and/or damages that the Dealer and/or customer will encounter due to renovation/upgrade after notifying the Dealer/Partner/customer in advance.

ARTICLE 7. FORCE MAJEURE

Vinpearl, Customers or Partners will not be responsible for delay or non-performance of the contract/agreement to provide and use services (except payment obligations) or the rights and obligations of each Party specified in the DKC and QDC if such delay or non-performance is caused by a Force Majeure event. Force Majeure events include but are not limited to: Storms, floods, earthquakes, wars, fires, changes in state policies and laws or other objective events.

With conditions:

documents.title: General regulations

sections.heading: A. INTRODUCTION
content: The following Rules and regulations have been issued by Vinpearl Joint Stock Company and Phu Quoc Tourism Development and Investment Joint Stock Company (hereinafter referred to as “Vinpearl”) to ensure safety, stability and protect the interests of Customers (“Guests”). The proposed regulations will be strictly implemented by the entire Management Board and staff of Vinpearl and VinOasis branded hotels. Vinpearl wants to ensure that all guests enjoy the amenities, services and benefits of the Hotels. In addition, the Guest's duties include "understanding and complying with the General Regulations to ensure Guests receive the best experience of the Services at the Hotel".

These General Regulations may be amended and supplemented from time to time according to Vinpearl's decision to improve the quality of Services and Guest experience and are determined on Vinpearl's official Website at https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-chung

sections.heading: B. GENERAL PROVISIONS
content: Comply with State and Hotel regulations on ensuring safety and disease prevention.
All guests coming to stay must bring valid identification documents according to the Regulations of the Accommodation Law.
Pets are not allowed in the Hotel area.

Smoking (including e-cigarettes) is only permitted in areas with permit signs and/or outside on room balconies. If violated, Guests must pay a compensation fee for restoration, deep cleaning, and deodorization of smell-stained equipment and utensils of VND 3,000,000 for a stay where smoking is detected in places where smoking is not allowed.
Comply with safety regulations when in vehicles moving within the Hotel area.

Behave properly in public places: Respect the first come, first served principle; Priority is given to pregnant women, people with disabilities, the elderly and weak; Do not make noise or scream; Do not put your feet or legs on chairs and do not do other unethical actions in public areas; Manage children in public areas.

Please keep valuables in the in-room safe or deposit them at the Front Desk. The Hotel is not liable for loss or damage to the Guest's personal property in case the Guest does not comply with the regulations.

When leaving the room, Guests need to ensure that (i) all electrical equipment has been returned to its original condition; (ii) the room door is securely locked; and (iii) do not give the room key to others.
Absolutely comply with the Hotel's regulations on cooking in the room and using electrical equipment for the right purpose.

At the villa: The kitchen is only used for the sole purpose of heating food/food. All forms of cooking and food processing that cause odors, smoke or do not ensure fire safety in the Villa/Apartment Kitchen are strictly prohibited. Any need to organize a BBQ in the garden or within the Villa/Apartment premises needs to be notified and registered with the Customer Service Center to be served (fees for these services will be calculated accordingly according to your requirements). The Hotel will not be responsible for food hygiene and safety issues when you prepare your own food within the Villa premises.

Do not bring food and/or drinks purchased from outside into the Hotel. If you bring food and drinks purchased outside into the Hotel, Guests need to notify the Hotel Management Board to control/pay the hotel an additional service fee of 1,175,000 VND/time. At the same time, the Hotel will not be responsible for food hygiene and safety issues when Guests use food and/or drinks not provided by the Hotel. Please sign the "Liability Waiver" when requested by the Hotel if using food sources not provided by the Hotel.
Do not bring fruits or strong-smelling foods (durian, jackfruit, fish sauce, etc.) into the hotel room.
No weapons, chemicals or explosives of any kind are allowed on the Hotel premises at any time.

Guests are responsible for compensation for damage to items and equipment in the room caused by the Guest. Compensation level for each item and equipment. Please refer to the list of items that will be charged/sold in the room.

Absolutely prohibit all acts of violating the law within the Hotel, including but not limited to acts of gambling, prostitution or use of stimulants/prohibited products (including electronic cigarettes, heated tobacco), fighting, etc. Guests must be fully responsible before the laws of Vietnam and the Hotel for any violations.

In case there is a guest visiting the Guest at the Hotel area, the Guest please notify the Reception and return the guest's identification documents at the Reception. In case of meeting in the room, the consent of the guest must be obtained and the guest must directly welcome the guest to the room. For security reasons, guests are not allowed to enter Guest rooms after 8:00 p.m. If the Guest wants to invite a guest to stay overnight, the guest must register with the Hotel Reception and pay the accommodation fee according to the Hotel's regulations.

Please comply with the operating hours of the swimming pool at the facility (may vary depending on the nature of the weather and season of the year). Guests using the swimming pool before and after operating hours (different facilities may have different closing/opening times depending on geography/season) must ensure and take responsibility for their own health and life safety without any complaints against the Hotel. The Hotel will close the swimming pool at the latest at 22:00 to avoid unfortunate accidents happening to guests. Please do not use the swimming pool after 10:00 p.m.

Beach area: Please do not swim after 7:00 p.m. because the hotel does not have security/rescue staff on duty after 7:00 p.m. Guests are fully responsible for their own health and life safety without any complaints against the Hotel if they intentionally swim after this time.

Guests please wear appropriate clothing when in common areas of the Hotel, especially in public areas such as the lobby, restaurant... to show respect for other cultures. Guests are absolutely not in a state of nudity, including children.

For room packages that include VinWonders tickets, use of games and services in the park must comply with regulations on age, height, weight and other safety conditions applicable to each game. Please see more information at VinWonders website.
Carry out other procedures according to regulations of Vinpearl and local accommodation management authorities from time to time (if any).
The Hotel Management Board may require Guests to leave the Hotel without refunding any fees for Guests who intentionally ignore and violate the Hotel's rules and regulations.

Noise regulations: after 10:00 p.m., the TV volume must not exceed 10. Do not play music with loud speakers or talk too loudly to ensure public order. Noise will be considered excessive when Hotel Guests feel disturbed or annoyed.
Carry out other procedures according to Vinpearl's regulations from time to time (if any).

sections.heading: 1.1. Check-in time:
content: Unless otherwise notified and/or confirmed by the Hotel:
1.1.1 Check-in time at the Hotel:
Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang: 14:00 on arrival day
Remaining hotels: 15:00 on arrival day

Requests for early check-in before the specified time must be notified in advance and confirmed by the Hotel depending on capacity and room availability but no earlier than 12:00 on the day of Guest's arrival.
1.1.2. Early check-in before 6:00 am will incur a fee equivalent to 100% of the purchased Room Package Price.
1.1.3. Early check-in from after 6:00 a.m. to 12:00 a.m. will incur a fee equivalent to 50% of the purchased Room Package Price.
1.1.4. Early check-in fees will be payable at the time the early check-in request is confirmed by the Hotel.

sections.heading: 1.2. Check-out time:
content: Unless otherwise notified and/or confirmed by the Hotel:
1.2.1. Check-out time at the Hotel is no later than 12:00 o'clock.

1.2.2. Guests can check out late depending on room availability confirmed by the Hotel and must pay additional fees as follows: 50% of Room Package Rate if checking out after 12:00 pm to 18:00 pm; 100% of Room Package Price if checking out after 18:00.

1.2.3. After completing the check-in procedures, the Guest will have to pay the Room Package Rate for the entire stay period as registered with the Hotel, regardless of whether the Guest checks out before the check-out time.

1.3. The above mentioned early check-in/late check-out fees will be calculated according to (i) Vinpearl's Published Price when Guests pay Vinpearl directly or (ii) the price according to the contract/agreement between Vinpearl and Partner if Partner is the paying party.

1.4. Vinpearl will record the image of the Customer's face when checking in for management using Facial Recognition Technology. By agreeing to check in, the Customer is understood to have been informed of this by Vinpearl and agrees that Vinpearl has the right to use the Customer's image as stipulated in Article 9.

sections.heading: ARTICLE 2. BOOKING POLICY

sections.heading: General content
content: This personal data protection policy describes how to collect, use and process personal data arising during the operation and business of Vinpearl Joint Stock Company (hereinafter referred to as "the Company") with address at Hon Tre Island, Vinh Nguyen Ward, Nha Trang City, Khanh Hoa Province, Vietnam and the official website is https://vinpearl.com.

sections.heading: 1. GENERAL PROVISIONS
content: 1.1. Personal Data: Is information in the form of symbols, letters, numbers, images, sounds or similar forms in the electronic environment that are associated with a specific person or help identify a specific person. Personal Data includes basic Personal Data and sensitive Personal Data.

1.2. Personal Data Subject: Is the individual reflected by Personal Data, including all individual customers who are using the Company's products and services, the Company's employees, shareholders and/or other individuals who have a legal relationship with the Company.

1.3. Processing of Personal Data: Is one or more activities affecting Personal Data, such as: collection, recording, analysis, confirmation, storage, editing, disclosure, combination, access, retrieval, retrieval, encryption, decryption, copying, sharing, transmission, provision, transfer, deletion, destruction of Personal Data or other related actions.

1.4. When Personal Data of a related person of an Individual Data Subject (including but not limited to information of a dependent, legally related person, spouse, child and/or parent and/or guardian, friend, beneficiary, authorized person, partner, emergency contact or other person of the Personal Data Subject) is provided to the Company, the Personal Data Subject and the related person of the Personal Data Subject Nhan represents, warrants and takes responsibility that the information has been fully provided and has been legally consented/approved by the Personal Data Subject to be processed for the purposes stated in this Policy. The Personal Data Subject and the related person of the Personal Data Subject agree that the Company is not responsible for verifying the legality or validity of this consent/acceptance and the storage of evidence is the responsibility of the related person of the Personal Data Subject and the Personal Data Subject. The Company is exempt from liability and required to compensate for damages and related costs when the Personal Data Subject or/and related person of the Personal Data Subject does not comply with the provisions herein.

1.5. By registering, using the Company's products and services, entering into a contract and/or allowing the Company to Process Personal Data, the Personal Data Subject accepts in full and without any conditions the policies mentioned herein and the changes (if any) from time to time.

1.6. This policy may be updated, amended, supplemented or replaced by the Company from time to time and posted by the Company on the Company's official website. You should visit and check our website regularly to stay informed of the most recent changes.
1.7. The Company commits to comply with the following principles when Processing Personal Data:
(i) The Company processes and protects Personal Data in accordance with Vietnamese law; fully comply with contracts, agreements and other documents established with Personal Data Subjects;

(ii) The Company collects Personal Data for specific, clear, lawful purposes, within the scope of the purposes stated in Section 3 of this Policy and in accordance with the provisions of Vietnamese law;

(iii) The Company always applies and updates technical measures in accordance with the provisions of Vietnamese law to ensure the security of Personal Data, including measures to protect against unauthorized access and/or destruction, loss, or damage to Personal Data;
(iv) The Company stores Personal Data appropriately and to the extent necessary to process it in accordance with the provisions of Vietnamese law;
(v) The Company is committed to complying with regulations related to children's data protection.

sections.heading: 2. PERSONAL DATA PROCESSED
content: In order for the Company to Process Personal Data for the purposes set out in Section 3 of this Policy, the Company may process the following types of Personal Data:
2.1. Basic Personal Data includes:
(i) Surname, middle name, birth name, other names (if any);
(ii) Date, month and year of birth; date, month, year of death or disappearance;
(iii) Gender;
(iv) Place of birth, place of birth registration, permanent residence, temporary residence, current residence, hometown, contact address;
(v) Nationality;

(vi) Images of individuals; information obtained from security systems, including image recordings of Personal Data Subjects on camera systems and surveillance cameras at the Company's business/transaction locations;

(vii) Phone number, identity card number, citizen identification number, personal identification number, passport number, driver's license number, license plate number, personal tax code number, social insurance number, health insurance card number;
(viii) Occupation, workplace;
(ix) Marital status;
(x) Information about family relationships (parents, children);
(xi) Information about individuals' digital accounts; Personal Data reflects interests and history of activities in cyberspace;
(xii) Other information that pertains to a specific person or helps identify a specific person is not within the scope of sensitive Personal Data as specified in Section 2.2 below.
2.2. Sensitive Personal Data includes the following key data:
(i) Political views, religious views;
(ii) Health status and private life recorded in medical records, excluding information about blood type;
(iii) Information related to racial and ethnic origin;
(iv) Information about inherited or acquired genetic characteristics of individuals;
(v) Information about physical attributes and biological characteristics of individuals;
(vi) Data on crimes and criminal acts collected and stored by law enforcement agencies;
(vii) Personal Data Subject's bank account information;
(viii) Data about the Customer's location determined through location services;
(ix) Other Personal Data defined by law as special and requiring necessary security measures.

sections.heading: 3. PURPOSE OF PROCESSING PERSONAL DATA
content: Personal Data may be processed for one or more of the following purposes:
3.1. Evaluate the ability to provide products, services or/and enter into contracts with Personal Data Subjects, including but not limited to the following purposes:
(i) Identify and verify information about Personal Data Subjects;

(ii) Evaluate, appraise and approve the provision of products and services according to registration documents, applications, contracts of Personal Data Subjects and/or related persons of Personal Data Subjects;
(iii) Consider providing or continuing to provide any of the Company's products or services to Personal Data Subjects;

3.2. Carry out obligations in contracts, agreements, terms, conditions and other documents between the Company and Personal Data Subjects, and provide customer support including but not limited to the following purposes:
(i) Perform obligations under contracts, agreements and provide products and services to Personal Data Subjects;
(ii) Update and process information of Personal Data Subjects;
(iii) Taking care of and resolving complaints and grievances of Personal Data Subjects;
(iv) Use and transfer to partners Personal Data and related information to identify and fix problems with products and services; product repair;
(v) Contact and notify Personal Data Subjects;
(vi) Implement promotional, gift exchange, reward, gift delivery, marketing and advertising programs;
(vii) Perform other customer care and support activities.
3.3. Improve the quality of the Company's products and services including but not limited to:
(i) Provide information that the customer has requested or that the Company finds useful to the customer;
(ii) Improve technology, website interface, social networks, and applications to ensure convenience for customers;
(iii) Manage customer accounts and customer loyalty programs implemented by Vingroup and its member companies;
(iv) Statistics and data analysis to research, build, develop and improve products and services; enhance customer experience;
(v) Develop and provide new products and services personalized according to customers' actual needs and conditions;
(vi) Introduce and provide promotional programs and incentives for the Company's products and services and the Company's cooperation with partners;
(vii) Recommend products and services that customers may be interested in through identifying customer preferences.

3.4. Serving the Company's business and operations includes, but is not limited to, performing reporting, financial, accounting and tax obligations, auditing and compliance activities and other activities serving the Company's legitimate business in cases that the Company considers necessary.
3.5. Restructuring and transferring projects/businesses:

During the course of business, the Company may sell or buy businesses or restructure businesses or transfer projects or other services in accordance with the provisions of law. Accordingly, Personal Data and the right to use the information in general are among the transferred assets. In all cases, the transfer and processing of data will be carried out by the parties in accordance with the provisions of law and this Policy.
3.6. Marketing: Building marketing campaigns, promoting products and services, including building campaigns based on customer preferences;
3.7. Prevent, combat, prevent, investigate and detect crimes.
3.8. Protect social order and safety, protect the legitimate rights and interests of Personal Data Subjects, the Company and other relevant parties.
3.9. Comply with the provisions of law and international treaties to which Vietnam is a member, including but not limited to:
(i) To provide to competent state agencies according to the provisions of law;
(ii) To carry out obligations prescribed by law and international treaties that the Company must comply with (if any).
3.10. Other purposes if consented to by the Personal Data Subject.

sections.heading: 4. HOW PERSONAL DATA IS PROCESSED
content: 4.1. Method of collection
Personal Data is collected as follows:
(i) From the Company's websites and applications: Personal Data is collected when Personal Data Subjects fill out forms posted on the Company's websites and applications.

(ii) From providing products and services, performing obligations under contracts and agreements of the Company: Personal Data is collected when the Personal Data Subject purchases, registers to use, uses any product or service, or signs a contract with the Company.

(iii) From exchanges and communications with Personal Data Subjects: Personal Data is collected through interactions between the Company and Personal Data Subjects (in person, by mail, telephone, online, switchboard system, electronic communication or any other means) including surveys;
(iv) From social networks: Are the Company's social networks and/or social networks cooperated by the Company with partners;

(v) From audio and video recording devices: located at stores, places of business or places where part or all of the Company's business activities are carried out where Personal Data Subjects meet, appear or interact with the Company;
(vi) From interactions or automatic data collection technologies: The Company may collect automatically logged information from connection:
· Cookies, pixel tags and other similar technologies;
· Any technology capable of tracking individual activities on devices or electronic information sites;
· Other data information provided by a device.
(vii) Other means

The Company may collect Personal Data through public, official information sources or through receiving necessary data sharing from parent companies, subsidiaries, affiliated companies, and partners during cooperation with the Company in accordance with the provisions of law.
4.2. Storage method
Personal Data is stored in Vietnam in the Company's database system or wherever we or our branches, subsidiaries, affiliates, partners or service providers have facilities.
The storage period for personal data is determined based on the purpose of use as stated in this Policy and in accordance with legal regulations.
4.3. How to transfer/share data

The Company will not sell Personal Data to any party. The Company uses necessary security measures to ensure the safe transfer/sharing of Personal Data. Personal Data is shared by the Company with (i) the Company's parent company, subsidiaries, and affiliated companies; (ii) individuals/organizations participating in the Processing of Personal Data specified in this Policy); or (iii) competent state agencies or other cases in accordance with the provisions of law.

If the receiving party of Personal Data is headquartered outside the territory of Vietnam, then when providing/transferring Personal Data abroad (including but not limited to the use of cyberspace, devices, electronic means or other forms to transfer Personal Data outside the territory of Vietnam), the Company will require the receiving party to ensure safety and security of the Personal Data provided/transferred. The Company commits to fully comply with the regulations and compliance requirements of Vietnamese law to protect the safety of Personal Data.
4.4. Analytical method
Personal Data is analyzed based on the Company's internal processes, data security principles and information security assurance for information technology systems.
4.5. Encoding method
Where necessary, Personal Data collected is encrypted according to appropriate encryption standards during data storage or transfer and processing to ensure that the data is always protected.
4.6. How to delete data
In accordance with the law or upon a valid request from a Personal Data Subject, the Company will delete stored Personal Data except in the following cases:
(i) The law does not allow data deletion or requires data storage;
(ii) Personal Data is processed by a competent state agency for the purpose of serving the activities of the state agency in accordance with the law;
(iii) Personal Data has been made public in accordance with the law;
(iv) Personal Data is processed to serve legal requirements, scientific research, and statistics in accordance with the law;

(v) In case of emergency regarding national defense, national security, social order and safety, major disasters, dangerous epidemics; when there is a threat to security and national defense but not to the extent of declaring a state of emergency; preventing and combating riots, terrorism, preventing and combating crime and law violations;
(vi) Respond to an emergency situation that threatens the life, health or safety of a Personal Data Subject or another individual.

Throughout the Processing of Personal Data, security is the Company's highest priority. The Company has appropriate technical measures to prevent unauthorized access and use of Personal Data. We also regularly coordinate with security experts to update the latest cyber security techniques to ensure the safety of Personal Data. Your payment card data issued by financial institutions is protected by the Company with the principle of not recording important payment card data (card number, full name, CVV number) on our system. Your payment transaction is made on the relevant bank's system.

sections.heading: 5. PROCESSING OF CHILDREN'S PERSONAL DATA
content: 5.1. The Company will process children's Personal Data in accordance with the principles of protecting the rights and best interests of children and in accordance with the law.

5.2. The Company only processes children's Personal Data and provides products and services to children, if the parent or guardian consents to the child's use of the Company's products and services, agrees to let the Company Process the child's Personal Data, agrees to this Policy and complies with relevant legal requirements. In the case of children 7 years of age or older using the Company's products and services, in addition to the requirements stated herein, the Company will only process the child's Personal Data with that child's consent. Parents or guardians are responsible for obtaining the child's consent before providing the child's Personal Data to the Company.

sections.heading: 6. UNWANTED CONSEQUENCES AND DAMAGES ARE POSSIBLE
content: 6.1. The Company uses many different information security technologies such as firewall systems, access control measures, encryption... to protect and prevent Personal Data from being accessed, used or shared illegally. However, the Company cannot commit to ensuring absolute security of Personal Data in some cases such as:
(i) Hardware and software errors during data processing cause loss of Personal Data Subject's data;
(ii) Security holes are beyond the Company's control, the system is attacked by hackers, causing data to be leaked.
6.2. The Company recommends that Personal Data Subjects keep information related to account login passwords and OTP codes confidential and not share this content with anyone else.

6.3. Personal Data Subjects should be aware that at any time when Personal Data Subjects disclose and make public their Personal Data, that data may be collected and used by others for purposes beyond the control of the Personal Data Subject and the Company.

6.4. The Company recommends that Personal Data Subjects protect personal devices (phones, tablets, personal computers...) during use. Personal Data Subjects should log out of their accounts when not in use.

6.5. In case the data storage server is attacked resulting in the loss, exposure or leakage of Personal Data, the Company will be responsible for reporting the incident to the investigating authorities for timely handling and notifying the Personal Data Subject in accordance with the law.

6.6. Cyberspace is not a secure environment and the Company cannot absolutely guarantee that Personal Data shared via cyberspace will always remain secure. When transmitting Personal Data through cyberspace, Personal Data Subjects should only use secure systems to access websites, applications or devices. The Personal Data Subject is responsible for keeping his or her access credentials for each website, application or device secure and confidential.

sections.heading: 7. START TIME AND END TIME OF PERSONAL DATA PROCESSING
content: 7.1. Personal Data is processed from the moment the Company lawfully receives the Personal Data and the Company has an appropriate legal basis to process the data in accordance with the law.
7.2. Personal Data will be processed until the purposes of data processing have been fulfilled.

7.3. The Company may be required to retain Personal Data even after the contract between the parties has ended in order to fulfill obligations according to legal regulations and/or requests from competent state agencies.

sections.heading: 8. ORGANIZATIONS AND INDIVIDUALS PARTICIPATING IN THE PROCESSING OF PERSONAL DATA
content: 8.1. Depending on the circumstances, the Company may be the controller of personal data or the controller and processor of personal data.

8.2. To the extent permitted by law, Personal Data Subjects understand that the Company may share Personal Data for the purposes stated in this Policy with the following organizations and individuals:
(i) Parent company, subsidiaries, and affiliated companies of the Company;

(ii) Organizations and individuals providing services and/or cooperating with the Company, including but not limited to: agents, auditors, lawyers, business cooperation partners, providing information technology solutions, software, applications, operation services, management, troubleshooting, and infrastructure development;
(iii) Any individual or organization that is the representative or authorized party of the Personal Data Subject, acting on behalf of the Personal Data Subject;

Data sharing will be done in accordance with the correct order, method and current legal regulations. The parties receiving Personal Data are obligated to keep Personal Data confidential in accordance with this Policy, internal regulations, the Company's standards for protecting Personal Data and current legal regulations.
8.3. The Company may be required to share Personal Data with competent state agencies according to law.

sections.heading: 9. RIGHTS OF PERSONAL DATA SUBJECTS
content: 9.1. The right to know about the Processing of your Personal Data, unless otherwise provided by law.
9.2. The right to consent or not to consent to the Processing of your Personal Data, unless otherwise required by law.
9.3. Right of access to view, edit or request correction of your Personal Data, unless otherwise required by law.
9.4. Right to withdraw consent.
9.5. Right to data deletion.
9.6. The right to restrict the Processing of your Personal Data in accordance with the law.
9.7. The right to request to provide yourself with your Personal Data, unless otherwise provided by law.
9.8. Right to object to data processing.
9.9. Right to complain, denounce and sue.
9.10. Right to claim compensation for damages.
9.11. Right to self-defense.

Personal Data Subjects may exercise these rights by making a request to the Company. The request form must be sent to the Company and has basic contents such as information of the requester, detailed request content [for example, type of data to be provided, name of document, record (if any) to be deleted), reason, purpose of making the request, relevant information depending on the specifics of the request (for example, the requested document needs to be in the form of a file or paper, document receipt address...). All costs (if any) arising from implementing the requests as stated herein including but not limited to printing, copying, postal fees, courier fees to send data will be borne by the requester and must be paid at the latest upon receipt of the data or a deadline set by the Company.

The Company will process requests from Personal Data Subjects in accordance with the law and consider the legitimate interests of Personal Data Subjects. However, in the event that a Personal Data Subject withdraws his or her consent, requests data deletion and/or exercises other related rights with respect to any or all of the Personal Data that affects the Company's ability to provide/maintain products and services to the Personal Data Subject or maintain the contractual relationship, depending on the nature of the Personal Data Subject's request, the Company may consider and decide on discontinuation of provision. the Company's products and services to the Personal Data Subject or terminate the contractual relationship between the Company and the Personal Data Subject. Actions taken by a Personal Data Subject under this provision shall be deemed to be a unilateral termination on the part of the Personal Data Subject of any relationship between the Personal Data Subject and the Company and may result in a breach of the obligations or contractual commitments between the Personal Data Subject and the Company, and the Company reserves the Company's legal rights and remedies in such cases. Accordingly, the Company shall not be liable to Personal Data Subjects for any losses incurred and the Company's legal rights shall be fully reserved. Using reasonable efforts, the Company will comply with a lawful and valid request from a Personal Data Subject within a timely manner in accordance with the law. However, for security purposes, the Company may require the Personal Data Subject to verify their identity before processing the Personal Data Subject's request.

The Company has the right to refuse to comply with the requests of Personal Data Subjects in certain cases, including but not limited to: (i) Personal Data Subjects do not follow the correct order and procedures instructed by the Company in which the requested content lacks information or is invalid; (ii) Personal Data Subject does not provide or does not provide sufficient documents to verify identity; or (iii) in case the Company assesses there are signs of fraud or violations of Personal Data protection; or (iv) The provisions of law do not allow the fulfillment of the Personal Data Subject's request.

sections.heading: 10. OBLIGATIONS OF THE PERSONAL DATA SUBJECT
content: 10.1. Self-protect Personal Data; Require other relevant organizations and individuals to protect their Personal Data. Promptly notify the Company when detecting any errors, mistakes, leaks of Personal Data or suspecting that Personal Data is being violated.
10.2. Respect and protect other people's personal data.

10.3. Provide complete and accurate Personal Data when agreeing to Process Personal Data. If there is any incorrect information, the Personal Data Subject will bear it at his own expense in case such information affects or limits the rights of the Personal Data Subject.
10.4. Implement legal regulations on personal data protection and participate in preventing and combating violations of personal data protection regulations.
10.5.Other responsibilities according to legal regulations.

sections.heading: 11. OTHER REGULATIONS
content: 11.1. The Personal Data Subject confirms that, by accepting this Policy, the Personal Data Subject has agreed to have Personal Data processed by the Company, organizations and individuals participating in the Personal Data Processing process as stated in this Policy, knowing clearly the type of data processed, the purpose of data processing, the organization or individual whose Personal Data is processed, and their rights and obligations related to Personal Data. The Personal Data Subject has been notified by the Company, knows and agrees with all the contents that need to be notified before Personal Data is processed by the Company, organizations and individuals participating in the Personal Data Processing process. Personal Data Subjects agree that the Company, organizations, and individuals participating in the Processing of Personal Data do not need to notify again before Processing Personal Data.

11.2. If you have any questions about the Company's personal data protection, please contact us and we will endeavor to answer your question as soon as possible. You can also contact us at the address below:
